title: Paul Maurice's band and its members
summary: Paul Maurice hired Joe; the band had Maurice on clarinet, a sax, Kingston Alexis on trumpet, Eddie Thomas on drums and Joe on piano.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: It seems that way. So, I played with them, oh, for quite a few years. We played the various spots, the yacht club, and different bands, all the old moves clubs, and so forth and so on. And as time went on, Eddie Watson, who played the guitar later, went to saxophone. So did his brother, Harry, who used to play trumpet. He'd taken an alto sax, and so did his brother. Well, he clicked on that way until later on, the old outfit busted up. Then came a time where I'd become to be known around this way as... as a pianist. Paul Maurice. Who? Paul Maurice had hired me to play along with them. Sam Bill Alston. That's right. So, with Paul, there was Harry, Frank McHugh, and the... Who were you playing at that time? Guitar or banjo? Banjo. Banjo. Banjo.
Paul Maurice, who was the leader, was on clarinet. We had Amadei De La Hussey. Saxophone. Saxophone. Saxophone. Saxophone. Saxophone.

Who is in California now. We had Kingston. Trumphant. Trumphant. Let's get his full name again, huh? Kingston what? That's Ripa, Alexis, brother. That's Ripa. Saxophone, who was in California now. We had Kingston's trumpet.
Let's get his full name again, huh? Kingston what?
That's Rico's Alexis, brother. Kingston's Alexis.
Yeah, well good, I wanted to get it. I didn't know if we had it down or not. Alexis.
Well, I knew Rico, I knew him.
Let's see, who was the drummer at this time? Do you remember Harry?
I was the standard drummer, Eddie Thomas.
